===Starting out===
{{Checklist|
*Talk to [[King Lathas]] on the {{FloorNumber|uk=1}} of [[Ardougne Castle]]. {{Chat option|1I am. What's our plan?|1Yes.}}
*Talk to [[Koftik]] in the westernmost part of [[West Ardougne]] next to the cave. {{Chat option|1I'll take my chances.}}
**Bring the rest of your supplies now, as after this section there is no turning back unless you want to restart the entire dungeon.
*Enter the cave and run south at the first junction.
*Talk to Koftik for a cloth. Use it on an arrow, then use your tinderbox on it or use the arrow on the fire on the ground.
*Go north to the gated area.
**'''{{Colour|red|Warning}}:''' If you dropped any items pick them up before you shoot the rope because you cannot pick them up afterwards, unless you pull the lever to go back across the bridge. If dropped close to the bridge they can be telegrabbed
*Equip your bow and fire arrow (be sure to light the arrow with your tinderbox), then shoot the guide rope attached to the bridge.
*Once across the bridge, take the plank in the north room (if you did not bring one).
*Continue through the cave until you reach a section with water and a pit. Ignore the water, use a rope on the rock above the pit. If you fail, you will lose your rope.
*Continue through the cave until you reach a large grid.
*Walk across the grid and use trial and error to find your path. You will fall through some of the tiles. Some paths are not possible, see the [[Underground Pass#The grid|full guide]] for solving this optimally.
**'''{{Colour|red|Warning}}:''' Keep your Hitpoints above 15 when crossing the grid.
}}
